hook: "Well, Speed, I'm Moved": Lincoln Comes to Springfield
text: Lincoln rode into town on the fifteenth of April with his saddlebags, and went to a general store on the square, run by a young man named Joshua Speed. He asked how much it would cost to buy the things he needed for a bed. It came to about seventeen dollars. Lincoln said that he did not have the money. Speed said there was a simpler way. Upstairs, above the store, he had a large room with a big double bed, and Lincoln was welcome to share it. Lincoln picked up his saddlebags, went up, put them down on the floor, came back down, and said, with a broad smile, well, Speed, I'm moved.
